texts.slot.game.help: The game: a Wii U archive (.wua, which may also hold the game's update and add-on content), a zip of a game's NUS folder (its encrypted .app files with title.tmd, title.tik and title.cert, as the console downloads them; it needs the Wii U common key as firmware), a homebrew bundle (.wuhb) or a program on its own (.rpx). Cemu makes .wua archives from a game's installed folders.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The console's saved games to start with: a zip as Export Save Data writes it (the files of the console's usr/save folder). Leave it empty to start with no saved games.
texts.setting.cpu_mode.about: How the console's processor is run. The recompiler turns the console's code into the computer's own and is many times faster; the interpreter runs one instruction at a time. Both give the same run every time, but they are two different machines, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.renderer.about: How the console's pictures are drawn: by Cemu's OpenGL renderer, on your graphics card. It is the only one this core has.
texts.setting.renderer.unknown: '%1' is not a renderer this core has.
texts.setting.cpu_mode.unknown: '%1' is not a CPU mode this core has.
texts.setting.screens.about: What the picture shows: the TV with the GamePad's screen under it, the TV alone, or the GamePad alone. The touch screen can be touched only where the GamePad's screen is shown, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.screens.unknown: '%1' is not a choice of screens this core has.
texts.setting.console_language.about: The language set in the console's settings, which games ask for. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.console_language.unknown: '%1' is not a console language this core has.
texts.setting.console_fonts.about: The fonts games ask the console for. The stand-in, the default, is a free font that Cemu carries (Lato): games start with no file, but their text looks different. Cemu's copies are the four font files upstream Cemu ships (CafeCn.ttf, CafeKr.ttf, CafeStd.ttf and CafeTw.ttf, in its resources/sharedFonts folder), given as firmware. The console's are the same four fonts as a Wii U has them (system title 0005001b-10042400), given as firmware; they are other files than Cemu's copies. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.console_fonts.unknown: '%1' is not a choice of fonts this core has.
texts.setting.occlusion_queries.about: What a game is told when it asks how much of an object was drawn (for lens flares, light shafts, or objects hidden behind walls). The card's count is what the graphics card counted, as in Cemu; it can differ between kinds of graphics card, so a movie may need the same kind of card to replay. Fake reports every object fully visible, the same on every card, so movies replay anywhere, at the cost of flares showing through walls. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.occlusion_queries.unknown: '%1' is not a choice of occlusion queries this core has.
texts.setting.clock_start.about: The date and time the console's clock shows when it is switched on. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.error.no_gpu: Cemu draws with OpenGL on the graphics card, and the core was given no graphics card.
texts.error.cannot_load: %1 could not be started: it is not a game or program that Cemu can start.
texts.error.not_a_title: %1 is not a Wii U game. The core takes a Wii U archive (.wua), a zip of a game's NUS folder, a homebrew bundle (.wuhb) or a program (.rpx).
texts.error.no_base_title: %1 holds no game, only an update or add-on content. Give the archive that holds the game itself.
texts.error.no_font: %1, one of the console's fonts, was not given. Give the four font files as firmware, or set Console Fonts to the stand-in.
texts.error.font_is_cemu_copy: %1 is Cemu's copy of a console font, not the console's own. Set Console Fonts to Cemu's copies.
texts.error.save_not_zip: %1 is not a zip: save data has to be a zip as Export Save Data writes it.
texts.error.save_not_storage: %1 holds %2, which is not in the console's save folder (usr/save/): it is not save data as Export Save Data writes it.
texts.error.save_entry_method: %2 in %1 is packed in a way this core cannot unpack.
texts.error.save_entry_not_written: %2 from %1 could not be written into the console's storage.
texts.slot.dlc.help: For a game given as a NUS zip: a zip of its add-on content's NUS folder. Leave it empty for none. A .wua archive holds its own add-on content.
texts.firmware.commonkey.about: The console's common key, which opens games in the NUS form: a file of its 16 bytes. Needed for a game given as a NUS zip; a .wua archive needs none.
texts.error.nus_no_key: %1 is a game in the NUS form, whose files are encrypted: give the Wii U common key as firmware (a file of its 16 bytes).
texts.error.key_not_a_key: %1 is not the Wii U common key: the key is a file of exactly 16 bytes.
texts.error.nus_not_zip: %1 is not a zip, or is a damaged one.
texts.error.nus_no_tmd: %1 holds no title.tmd: it is not a zip of a game's NUS folder (its .app files with title.tmd, title.tik and title.cert).
texts.error.nus_entry_locked: %2 in %1 is protected by a password, which this core cannot open.
texts.error.nus_entry_compressed: %2 in %1 is compressed. Make the zip without compression: the files are encrypted and get no smaller.
texts.error.nus_damaged: %1 is damaged: one of its files could not be read.
texts.error.nus_no_ticket: %1 holds no title.tik, the ticket that opens the game's files.
texts.error.nus_cannot_decrypt: The files in %1 could not be read with the common key given: the key is not the Wii U common key, or the files are damaged.
texts.error.dlc_without_nus: %1 is add-on content in the NUS form, which goes with a game given as a NUS zip. A .wua archive holds its own add-on content.
texts.error.dlc_not_dlc: %1 is not add-on content: give the zip of the NUS folder of the game's add-on content.
texts.error.no_mii_resource: %1, one of the console's Mii resource files, was not given. Give the files as firmware, or set Mii Resource to none.
texts.setting.mii_resource.unknown: '%1' is not a choice of Mii resource this core has.
texts.setting.mii_resource.about: The console's Mii resource: the four files of its system title 0005001b-10056000 that games read to draw Miis. The console's are files you give as firmware (FFLResHigh.dat, FFLResHighLG.dat, FFLResMiddle.dat and FFLResMiddleLG.dat, from your console). None gives the console no Mii resource, and a game that draws Miis may then fail. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.firmware.fflreshigh.about: FFLResHigh.dat, one of the four files of the console's Mii resource: from a Wii U (system title 0005001b-10056000, its content folder). Needed when Mii Resource is set to the console's.
texts.firmware.fflreshighlg.about: FFLResHighLG.dat, one of the four files of the console's Mii resource: from a Wii U (system title 0005001b-10056000, its content folder). Needed when Mii Resource is set to the console's.
texts.firmware.fflresmiddle.about: FFLResMiddle.dat, one of the four files of the console's Mii resource: from a Wii U (system title 0005001b-10056000, its content folder). Needed when Mii Resource is set to the console's.
texts.firmware.fflresmiddlelg.about: FFLResMiddleLG.dat, one of the four files of the console's Mii resource: from a Wii U (system title 0005001b-10056000, its content folder). Needed when Mii Resource is set to the console's.
texts.firmware.cafecn.cemu.about: CafeCn.ttf, one of the console's four shared fonts: as upstream Cemu ships it, from its resources/sharedFonts folder. Needed when Console Fonts is set to Cemu's copies.
texts.firmware.cafecn.console.about: CafeCn.ttf, one of the console's four shared fonts: as a Wii U has it, from a console (system title 0005001b-10042400, its content folder). Needed when Console Fonts is set to the console's own.
texts.firmware.cafekr.cemu.about: CafeKr.ttf, one of the console's four shared fonts: as upstream Cemu ships it, from its resources/sharedFonts folder. Needed when Console Fonts is set to Cemu's copies.
texts.firmware.cafekr.console.about: CafeKr.ttf, one of the console's four shared fonts: as a Wii U has it, from a console (system title 0005001b-10042400, its content folder). Needed when Console Fonts is set to the console's own.
texts.firmware.cafestd.cemu.about: CafeStd.ttf, the console's standard shared font (Latin letters and Japanese): as upstream Cemu ships it, from its resources/sharedFonts folder. Needed when Console Fonts is set to Cemu's copies.
texts.firmware.cafestd.console.about: CafeStd.ttf, the console's standard shared font (Latin letters and Japanese): as a Wii U has it, from a console (system title 0005001b-10042400, its content folder). Needed when Console Fonts is set to the console's own.
texts.firmware.cafetw.cemu.about: CafeTw.ttf, one of the console's four shared fonts: as upstream Cemu ships it, from its resources/sharedFonts folder. Needed when Console Fonts is set to Cemu's copies.
texts.firmware.cafetw.console.about: CafeTw.ttf, one of the console's four shared fonts: as a Wii U has it, from a console (system title 0005001b-10042400, its content folder). Needed when Console Fonts is set to the console's own.
